definition.en: Sea peoples of the Malay world who lived on boats and along the coasts. Some groups served the Malay rulers as navigators, rowers and patrols.
definition.zh: 马来世界里以船为家、沿海而居的族群。其中一些群体替马来统治者领航、划船和巡守海面。

definition.en: A senior office of the Johor sultanate, responsible for order and for the sea peoples. In 1819 the Temenggong at Singapore was Abdul Rahman.
definition.zh: 柔佛苏丹国的高级官职，负责治安，也管辖海人。1819 年住在新加坡的天猛公是阿都拉曼。

definition.en: A port that charges no duties on goods coming in or going out. Colonial Singapore raised its money in other ways, above all from revenue farms.
definition.zh: 对进出口货物不征关税的港口。殖民地时期的新加坡改从别处筹钱，主要靠饷码。

definition.en: The right to run a monopoly, such as selling opium or spirits or keeping gambling houses, which the government sold to the highest bidder for a fixed period.
definition.zh: 政府把某项专卖权（如卖鸦片、卖酒、开赌馆）按期拍卖给出价最高的商人，商人付钱后在期限内独家经营。

definition.en: The British colony formed in 1826 from Penang, Malacca and Singapore; the Dindings and Labuan were added later. It was dissolved in 1946.
definition.zh: 1826 年由槟城、马六甲和新加坡组成的英国殖民地，后来加入天定和纳闽，1946 年解散。

definition.en: A colony governed directly by the British government through the Colonial Office, not by the East India Company or British India. The Straits Settlements became one in 1867.
definition.zh: 由英国政府通过殖民地部直接管理的殖民地，不再经东印度公司或英属印度。海峡殖民地 1867 年改为直辖殖民地。

definition.en: Malay for village or settlement. In the colonial town plan the word was also used for the areas set aside for particular communities.
definition.zh: 马来语，意思是村落、聚居地。殖民地的城区规划也用这个词称呼划给某个族群的地段。

definition.en: A word used in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries for Asian labourers hired for heavy physical work, often through labour brokers. It is now considered insulting; this topic uses it only when quoting the period.
definition.zh: 19、20 世纪对经中介招募、出卖体力的亚洲劳工的称呼。今天这个词带有贬义，本主题只在引述当时的说法时使用。

definition.en: A broker paid a migrant’s passage, and the migrant repaid the debt by working, often for a year or more, for an employer who bought the debt. Debt could leave workers with little choice.
definition.zh: 由客头先垫付移民的船费，移民上岸后被“卖”给买下这笔债的雇主，以做工抵债，往往要做一年以上。欠债的人常常身不由己。

definition.en: A way of recruiting Indian workers in which a foreman, the kangany, went back to his home district to bring labourers, mainly for plantations.
definition.zh: 招募印度劳工的一种办法：由工头（甘加尼）回到家乡招人，带他们来做工，主要去种植园。

definition.en: A Chinese association. The word could mean a business partnership, a mutual-help society or a secret society; clan associations and secret societies were different organisations. Secret societies were banned in 1890.
definition.zh: 华人的结社组织。“公司”可以指合股生意、互助团体，也可以指秘密会党；宗乡会馆和私会党是不同的组织。私会党在 1890 年被取缔。

definition.en: Families born locally in the Malay world whose language, food and customs mix those of their ancestors with local ones. The word is used for Chinese Peranakans and also for Indian and other Peranakan communities.
definition.zh: 在马来世界本地出生、语言饮食和习俗融合了祖籍文化与本地文化的家族。最常指土生华人，也有土生印度人等其他群体。

definition.en: A British official placed beside a Malay ruler. The ruler was bound to ask and act on his advice in everything except Malay religion and custom.
definition.zh: 英国派驻在马来统治者身边的官员。除了伊斯兰教和马来习俗之外，统治者必须征询并听从他的意见。

definition.en: From 1959 an elected Singapore government ran domestic affairs, while Britain kept defence and foreign affairs; internal security was shared.
definition.zh: 1959 年起，新加坡民选政府管理内政，国防和外交仍归英国，内部安全由双方共管。

definition.en: Singapore’s joining with Malaya, Sabah and Sarawak to form Malaysia in 1963. The terms were argued over before and after.
definition.zh: 1963 年新加坡与马来亚、沙巴、砂拉越组成马来西亚。合并的条件在合并前后都有争议。

definition.en: Indonesia’s political and armed campaign against the new Malaysia, from 1963 to 1966, including raids in Borneo and bombs in Singapore.
definition.zh: 印度尼西亚在 1963 年至 1966 年间反对马来西亚成立的政治与武装行动，包括在婆罗洲的越境袭击和在新加坡的爆炸。
